titre: Control Test n°2 — English (5th year primary)

exercices.enonce:
Reading - Comprehension
Read the text then answer the questions.

Every day, Karim gets up at seven o'clock. He washes his face and brushes his teeth. He has breakfast at half past seven. He goes to school at eight o'clock. He studies until noon. In the afternoon, he does his homework. In the evening, he watches TV and reads a book. He goes to bed at nine o'clock.

Questions:
1) What time does Karim get up? (1 pt)
2) What does he do after he washes his face? (1 pt)
3) What time does he go to school? (1 pt)
4) What does he do in the afternoon? (1 pt)
5) What does he do in the evening? (2 pts)

Telling the time
Write the time in words:
a) 7:00 ← ...
b) 7:30 ← ...
c) 8:00 ← ...
d) 9:00 ← ...

Complete
Complete with: ( breakfast - school - homework - bed )
a) I have ....... in the morning.
b) I go to ....... at eight.
c) I do my ....... in the afternoon.
d) I go to ....... at night.

Grammar - Present simple
Complete with the correct verb:
a) He ....... (get) up early.
b) She ....... (go) to school.
c) They ....... (watch) TV.

Writing
Write 3 sentences about your daily activities (what you do and at what time).

Weather.
Match the weather word with its description. Write the letter.
1) sunny
2) rainy
3) cloudy
a) clouds in the sky
b) sun shining
c) rain falling
